literal: Even if by fate it is not possible, effort will give the wages for its own body-wearying labor.
translation: Even if destiny makes a task impossible, one's honest effort will still yield the wages due for the physical labor spent.
modern: விதியினால் ஒரு செயல் முடியாமல் போனாலும், முயற்சி செய்வதனால் ஏற்படும் உடம்பின் வருத்தத்திற்கு ஏற்ற பலனை அந்த முயற்சி தரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of personal effort over fate. Even when external circumstances or destiny make the ultimate goal unattainable, the physical exertion put into the task does not go to waste. The effort itself guarantees a return proportional to the bodily pain and labor endured. This teaches that while success might sometimes be blocked by factors beyond control, honest labor always yields its own reward and is never entirely in vain.
